# TinyWL provenance

`src/backend.c` derives from `tinywl/tinywl.c` at wlroots tag **0.20.2**:
https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/wlroots/wlroots/-/blob/0.20.2/tinywl/tinywl.c

Downloaded on 2026-09-23. The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE` here.
Local changes integrate the C++/Lua configuration interface, mouse bindings,
window arrangement, background, reload and process lifecycle management.
Upstream tutorial comments have been shortened. This is a modified adapter,
not an unmodified vendored copy; do not overwrite it when updating wlroots.
